notes: Exactly 10 build menu modules. Every option has an explicit Cost Card (GAIN, PAY, RISK) and sol-time build duration so no choice is ever free or strictly optimal.

buildings.name: Solar Panels
buildings.gain: +12 kW clean daytime electricity to run life support and charge batteries.
buildings.pay: 75 kg Metal, 20 kg Regolith, 10 kWh build energy, 0.35 Sols build time.
buildings.risk: Produces 0 kW during the 14-day lunar night or heavy Martian dust storms, and loses power when coated in dust.

buildings.name: Battery Bank
buildings.gain: +80 kWh extra battery storage to survive nights and sudden storms.
buildings.pay: 110 kg Metal, 35 kg Regolith, -0.3 kW control drain, 0.4 Sols build time.
buildings.risk: Does NOT generate new energy! Without enough solar or backup generators, larger batteries still drain empty.

buildings.name: Kilopower Backup
buildings.gain: +10 kW steady 24/7 nuclear fission power — ignores lunar nights and Martian dust storms!
buildings.pay: 260 kg Metal, 140 kg Regolith, 25 kWh startup energy, 0.75 Sols build time.
buildings.risk: Very heavy metal cost slows down other builds and generates extra waste heat that stresses life-support cooling.

buildings.name: Water & O2 Recycler
buildings.gain: +4.0 kg/sol breathable Oxygen and boosts closed-loop water recovery toward 98%.
buildings.pay: 140 kg Metal, -5.0 kW continuous power, -1.0 L/sol process water, 0.5 Sols build time.
buildings.risk: High constant power draw! If your battery hits 0%, the recycler shuts off and oxygen drops fast.

buildings.name: Greenhouse
buildings.gain: Grows fresh crops (+2.6 kg/sol food) plus +1.5 kg/sol bonus Oxygen from plant photosynthesis.
buildings.pay: 165 kg Metal, -4.5 kW LED grow-light power, -3.0 L/sol water, 0.6 Sols build time.
buildings.risk: Plants thirst for water and power. Neglecting the Garden Guide or losing power can wilt crops overnight.

buildings.name: Radiation Shelter
buildings.gain: Raises Shielding to 96% when crew bunkers inside, blocking deadly solar proton storms.
buildings.pay: 220 kg Metal, 320 kg Regolith, -1.5 kW life-support vent power, 0.8 Sols build time.
buildings.risk: Expensive in regolith and metal, and while crew is bunkered, outdoor research and repairs pause.

buildings.name: Dust Cleaner / Seals
buildings.gain: Cuts solar dust buildup by 65% and unlocks automatic electrostatic panel wiping.
buildings.pay: 120 kg Metal, -2.0 kW electrostatic coil power, 0.45 Sols build time.
buildings.risk: Consumes steady electricity every sol even on calm, dust-free days.

buildings.name: Comms Antenna
buildings.gain: Doubles solar flare warning lead time and speeds up Mission Control uplink & Science data.
buildings.pay: 100 kg Metal, -2.2 kW transmitter power, 0.4 Sols build time.
buildings.risk: Does not shorten Mars speed-of-light delay! Extra antenna draw increases nighttime battery drain.

buildings.name: Rover Garage
buildings.gain: Unlocks surface Rover Trips to gather regolith, metal alloy, ice, and Science Points.
buildings.pay: 170 kg Metal, -2.5 kW charging bay power, 0.65 Sols build time.
buildings.risk: Every Rover Trip spends Oxygen & Battery and exposes crew to higher radiation if launched during a flare!

buildings.name: Regolith Sinterer
buildings.gain: Melts local soil into thick radiation-blocking domes (+35% baseline Shield) & mines regolith.
buildings.pay: 210 kg Regolith, 135 kg Metal, -3.5 kW microwave laser power, 0.7 Sols build time.
buildings.risk: Heavy laser power draw can trigger a grid brownout if built before your power surplus is ready.
